background_setting: An urban city street on a clear, sunny day. Multi-story buildings with storefronts and windows line both sides of the road. The ego vehicle travels in the right lane which is undergoing reconstruction, with a freshly poured rectangular concrete slab occupying the lane ahead, framed by low wooden forms and orange cones. The adjacent left lane remains open and clear for traffic. Painted lane markings, curbs, sidewalks, parked vehicles, and street signage are visible. The road surface leading up to the concrete is dry asphalt, contrasting with the wet grey slab.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from upper right, casting consistent directional shadows
lighting.shadows: Sharp, consistent shadows cast to the left of vehicles, cones, and the worker; the wet concrete reflects bright sky highlights
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast, crisp daylight illumination that emphasizes the glossy wet sheen of the concrete against the matte dry asphalt

aesthetics.composition: Central one-point perspective down the road with the ego lane leading directly into the wet concrete patch; the open adjacent lane on the left, construction elements clustered center-right
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant greys of concrete and asphalt, punctuated by high-visibility orange cones and vest, muted urban building tones, blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating row of orange cones and rhythmic lane markings

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion following the vehicle's path; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot ego perspective from behind the windshield
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the road ahead and the wet concrete patch

context: Autonomous vehicle perception failure demonstration where the ego vehicle fails to recognize a wet concrete road hazard

actions.description: Ego vehicle cruises down the city street at normal speed, the wet concrete patch and construction zone coming into view ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Vehicle approaches the concrete edge without slowing; cones and worker become clearly visible. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Vehicle drives straight onto the wet concrete at cruising speed, disturbing the surface, as the worker reacts with alarm. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

segments.description: The ego vehicle travels down the city street under clear daylight, approaching the section of lane under reconstruction. The rectangular wet concrete slab, wooden forms, orange cones, and worker with trowel come into full view ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: The construction zone grows larger in frame as the vehicle closes the distance without any speed change.
segments.camera: Steady forward tracking dashcam motion; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

segments.description: Failing to recognize the wet surface, the ego vehicle continues at cruising speed and drives directly onto the glistening wet concrete, disturbing its smooth surface as the worker looks up in alarm. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Vehicle transitions from dry asphalt onto wet concrete; concrete surface disturbed; worker reacts.
segments.camera: Continued steady forward tracking as the view moves onto the wet slab; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam shows the ego vehicle cruising down a sunny city street, buildings lining both sides and a clear open lane to the left. By 0:01 a rectangular patch of glistening wet grey concrete appears ahead in the ego lane, bordered by low wooden forms and a row of bright orange cones. At 0:02 a worker in an orange vest and hard hat is visible at the concrete's edge, bent over with a trowel smoothing the surface, while the vehicle maintains its cruising speed. By 0:03 the vehicle reaches the concrete edge without slowing. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle drives straight onto the wet slab at normal speed, disturbing the smooth glistening surface as the worker looks up in alarm, the tires rolling into the fresh concrete. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady ambient engine hum and tire noise on asphalt, faint city traffic and distant construction sounds. As the vehicle reaches the concrete, a subtle change in tire sound occurs along with a faint shout of alarm from the worker. No music or narration.
